from pydantic import BaseModel, Field

class CourtDocument(BaseModel):
    """One court document with its title and stated cause of action."""
    document_title: str | None = Field(description="The title or label of this court document")
    case_cause: str | None = Field(description="The stated cause of action/案由 for this case")
    document_number: str | None = Field(description="Optional document identifier if provided")
    quote: str | None = Field(description="Short excerpt from document supporting these facts")

class Parse(BaseModel):
    documents: list[CourtDocument]
